children: Coinbase Global (COIN), Strategy (MSTR): Shares of the cryptocurrency firms closed down 4.4% and 2.6%, respectively, after the Senate failed to pass the Clarity Act, a sweeping crypto bill that would have helped usher digital assets into the mainstream financial system.
Intel (INTC): The chip makers's shares rose 4% as AI-linked stocks largely recovered from their battering earlier in the week.
Reliance Worldwide (AU: RWC): Shares of the Australia-listed plumbing-supplies manufacturer jumped 3.5% after Brookfield Asset Management agreed to acquire it in an all-cash deal.

Reckitt Benckiser (UK:RKT): The maker of Mucinex and Lysol is doubling down on U.S. product development and manufacturing to respond more quickly to shifts in consumer demand. Shares edged lower in London.

Fraser Group (UK: FRAS): Hugo Boss appointed the chief executive of U.K. retailer Frasers Group, which has a near majority ownership of the German apparel company, as the next chairman of its supervisory board. Shares of Frasers dropped 2.6%.
